title: MEASURE TWICE, CUT ONCE: QUANTIFYING BIAS AND FAIRNESS IN DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS
reasoning: The paper's primary contribution is the introduction and validation of new metrics (CEV and SDE) specifically designed to quantify bias and fairness in machine learning models. Fairness is a core ethical concept, and the paper is dedicated to its quantitative evaluation, which constitutes a form of benchmarking the ethical performance of a model, going beyond a mere mention of ethical considerations.
